observations: Two photos show many blue cylindrical drums stacked outdoors/in a yard.
Each drum has a circular metal lid/cover on top with a central opening/hole.
There are small rectangular warning/label stickers on the drum faces/lids.
The drums show visible wear/scuffs and some surface discoloration/rust-like marks around edges.
No readable brand/model text is visible; only generic labels/stickers.

identity.kind: plastic/metal chemical storage drums (blue), multiple units

claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show blue drums with lids and labels, but material type ('plastic') and suitability for 'any kind of liquid' cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: Material mismatch: seller says 'plastic' but photos look like drums with metal lids/possibly metal-bodied or composite; wrong material affects chemical compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the drum body edge/cut section or a statement of material (HDPE/plastic vs steel) plus thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used drums with uncertain material/chemical compatibility.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/size: price depends heavily on liters/gallons (e.g., 20L/25L/50L/200L). Photos don’t show dimensions.
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo (height and diameter) or the exact capacity in liters.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case assumption for value (small/unknown capacity) until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition/fitness: visible scuffs and wear could mean dents/leaks; photos can’t confirm watertightness.
risks.proof: Ask for a video test: fill with water briefly or show leak test/inside condition (no cracks, no holes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/possibly not leak-proof (worst case).

risks.risk: Previous contents/contamination: labels are present but not readable; drums may have held chemicals that reduce usability for food/water.
risks.proof: Ask what the drums were previously used for and request a clear photo of the label text (contents/UN code).

risks.risk: Quantity/availability: photos show many drums, but the listing may be for a specific number; buyer needs the exact count per purchase.
risks.proof: Ask how many drums are included per unit price (e.g., per drum) and confirm total available.
risks.if_unproven: Price per single drum only, not assuming bulk discount.

proof_requests: Confirm drum material (HDPE/plastic vs steel/composite) with a close-up of the body edge and/or thickness.
Provide exact capacity (liters) with a tape-measure photo (height and diameter).
Show clear photos of the label text (contents/UN code) and state what the drums were last used for.
Provide a leak-proof proof: short video showing the lid seal area and (if possible) a water fill test or confirmation of no cracks/holes.
response.reason: The photos show used blue drums, but key pricing drivers (exact capacity, confirmed material, and leak/condition) are not verifiable from the images, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set without the missing proof.
